evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/c/a/a contains a large ID-keyed mutation table operating only on rs/d/r definitions; it changes action arrays, model arrays and other presentation/definition fields for hundreds of concrete IDs.
The rs/d/r decode/finalize path invokes rs/c/a/a.a(definition,id) only when rs/d/r.E equals enum value OLDSCHOOL.
jdeps shows the only project dependency pair is rs.c.a.a <-> rs.d.r: the override table depends on the definition type and the definition loader calls the table directly.

The target rs/d/r definition owns item-style name/action/model state, item-ID lookup/caching and definition decode methods, fixing the override domain as item definitions rather than generic interface or object data.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the OLDSCHOOL-mode item-definition mutation table. It does not claim a verbatim original developer class name.
